## Pause gates (S1-B-3, 2026-11-13)

The pause machinery: `game_paused` is set by the two C# sources — the focus
pause (`FocusHelper.cs:67-77`, `Main.cs:17130-17141`; an unfocused window
freezes the world unless `play_when_unfocused`, with the pointer-release
edges cleared) and the in-world gate `App::can_pause_game` (`CanPauseGame`,
`Main.cs:17194-17201/17315-17327`) — and the world body gates on
`step_allowed` (`Main.cs:17278`) whose stepper half is `world_stepper.rs`, a
verbatim `WorldUpdateStepper.cs` port, with `game_update_count`
(`Main.cs:6444`) pinning the step count. The deliberate deviations:

- **`DoUpdate_WhilePaused` is a shell** (`Main.cs:17329-17407`,
  `app/mod.rs::do_update_while_paused`). The C#'s portable arms resolve
  elsewhere in the port: the inventory toggle, the wheel scrolling and the
  held-item drops are event-driven and run while paused already; the armor
  display rows are draw-driven; the tile-target arms (`Player.tileTargetX/Y`
  + `LookForTileInteractions`/`ChestChangeEvents`/`UpdateNearbyCraftingTiles`,
  `:17398-17406`) stay frozen — the port fuses them into the step-gated
  `update_editing`, so no target updates while paused (the C# polls them in
  the paused body).
- **The absent arms**: the `ManageControlsMenu` controls-rebind half, the
  creative menu and the `RefreshInfoAccs` info-accessories pass have no port
  equivalent, and `LocalPlayer.sign >= 0` has no sign UI to gate (both in
  `can_pause_game` and the shell).
- **The audio focus gates** (`PauseSounds`/`AllowMusic`) are deferred to the
  sound rows (S1-E-21/24) — the port has no sound engine yet.
- **`DrawnThisUpdate`** (`WorldUpdateStepper.cs:9`) is tracked 1:1 (false at
  the step head, `Main.cs:17747`; true on the draw side, `:62478`) but its
  emit-effect consumers are unported (S1-E-1) — nothing reads it yet.
- **The Update/Draw fusion**: the C# returns early from `Update` while
  paused and `Draw` keeps running; the port's fused frame turns that return
  into branch gating — `step_allowed` skips the world pass, draw never
  skips. Same pixels: the frozen world still renders, the UI stays live.
- **The one-frame-lag EmoteBubble quirk** (the C# pause body leaving the
  bubble to draw from the last update's state) is not reproduced — the
  port's emote bubbles keep their live draw while paused.
- **`pauseworld`** (the stepper's `Paused`, `ToolkitDebugCommands.cs:742-749`)
  rides the debug panel's World-tab row — the port has no chat-command
  dispatcher; the step-key set is End/NumpadAdd/XButton1
  (`GetStepKeyState`, `:39-43`) mapped onto winit's Back.
- **The map reveal keeps the pause gate only** (no stepper gate): its C#
  source is the draw-side `LightingEngine.ExportToMiniMap` export
  (`LightingEngine.cs:246-270`) — draw runs on stepper-blocked frames, so
  vanilla keeps revealing the map while the world steps are frozen.
## The dodge family (S1-C-1, 2026-11-13)

`Player.Hurt`'s dodge roll block (`Player.cs:38214-38241`) lands in
`player.rs::hurt_inner` — sash → belt → brain → shadow, each roll drawn from
the caller's stream (`&mut dyn DropRng`, the `damage_var` parameter pattern)
only while its source is armed and no earlier source dodged; a dodge returns
`false` (hp untouched) after `SetImmuneTimeForAllTypes`'s write —
`immune = true` + `immuneTime = time` on the fields R-03-5 ported
(`immuneNoBlink` untouched, like the C#) plus the collapsed `hurtCooldowns` →
`hurt_cd = (long_invince ? 120 : 80)/60` — the 120/80 pair is its own value
set, `iframes_for` (the normal 40/20 window) is not involved. The brain's
`Next(6)` precedes the `FindBuffIndex(321)` check in the C# `&&` chain, so the
draw happens whenever item 3223 is armed even while buff 321 is active (buff
321 only gates the dodge itself) — the port keeps that draw order verbatim.
The armed-flag equivalents fold in `ResetEffects`' stand-in: items
963/984/6189/3223 re-arm per tick from `equipped[..10]`, buff 59 arms
`shadow_dodge` in the buff scan; `shadow_dodge_timer` decays at the tick head
(`:25461-25464`), the brain's animation counter in the fold (`:18794-18797`)
and zeroes on respawn (`UpdateDead` `:16932`). Merge note (2026-11-13): the
handlers' `immune`/`immuneTime` writes meet R-03-5's spawn i-frames — a dodge
during the 180-tick revive window overwrites `immuneTime` down to 80/120,
exactly the C# `SetImmuneTimeForAllTypes` semantics; the `!immune` General
gate in `hurt_inner` is R-03-5's and sits before the roll block, per `Hurt`'s
cooldown early-return.

Documented gaps, all deliberate:

- **The dust/gore bursts** (`DoMysticSashDodge`'s 50x dust 267 + 5x gore,
  `NinjaDodge`'s 100x dust 31 + 5x gore) have no particle/gore pool —
  deferred to **S1-E-1**; the handlers carry the immunity + bookkeeping only.
- **The shimmer-dodge arm** (`shimmering && AllowShimmerDodge(...)`,
  `:38201-38204`) needs the `shimmering` absorbed-state machine and the
  `PlayerDeathReason`/`CanHitPastShimmer` model — neither is ported; the
  block's order reserves the arm's slot (first in `Hurt`) for it.
- **The Hallowed `onHitDodge` grant** (`:6938-6941`, buff 59's source) is an
  armor-set row — the buff can be granted only by tests/debug today.
- **`long_invince` is consume-only**: the 120/80 read exists, its arming
  sources (item 6187 et al., `:14590/:14627/:15147/:15589`) ride C-7.
- **The panic/squire hurt buffs** (`:38242-38247`, `AddBuff(63, 480)` /
  `AddBuff(205, 300)`) ride S1-C-7.
- **`brain_of_confusion_dodge_animation_counter`** has no render consumer
  (the S1-A-9 dead-slot convention) — carried for state parity.
- **The contact/thorns restructure** (Phase 2, landed): the contact block runs
  `Update_NPCCollision`'s order (`Player.cs:31387-31426`) — `DamageVar(-luck)`
  → the thorns reflect gated on the PRE-hit `hurt_cd <= 0` (the `!immune`
  stand-in) → `Hurt(dodgeable: npc.is_damage_dodgeable())` — so a dodged
  contact still reflects (the C# arms run before `Hurt`).
- **`IsDamageDodgeable`'s port-state arms** (Phase 2, landed): the 35/127 arm
  (`NPC.cs:78744-78753`) keys on the ported `SkeletronHead`/`SkeletronPrime`
  kinds reading `ai[1] != 2f` verbatim; the Dungeon Guardian (`case 68`) and
  the Empress of Light (`case 636`, `!ShouldEmpressBeEnraged()`) have no port
  kind, so their arms are out with them (the default-true tail covers a
  future port). The Skeletron Head's port AI (`update_skeletron`) leaves
  `ai[1]` at 0 (its `cast_windup` stand-in) — the gate reads the field and
  evaluates true until the real machine lands; Prime's machine
  (`update_prime`) maintains `ai[1]` live. The projectile gate
  (`Projectile.cs:15064-15071` — kinds 871-874/919/923-924 at exactly-9999
  damage) is fully keyed; the port's `Projectile.kind` is the vanilla id.
- **The hazard/lava/fall callers keep `dodgeable = true`** (`Hurt`'s default,
  `Player.cs:38197`) — a black belt eats spike, lava and fall damage
  (vanilla); the Paladin MP-only `dodgeable: false` site (`:38361`) is
  unreachable in the port.

## The magic cuffs (S1-C-7 wave A, 2026-11-18)

`Player.Hurt`'s `magicCuffs` arm (`Player.cs:38291-38303`) lands in
`player.rs::hurt_inner`, slotted between the defense reduction (`:38247`) and
the endurance step (`:38304`): `num3 = (int)(num * 1f)` is the RAW incoming
damage (the C# `num` at `:38246` — the defense-reduced `num2` never feeds it),
`statMana += num3` capped at `statManaMax2` (`:38295-38298`), and
`ManaEffect(num3)` (`:4531-4538`) queues the HealMana combat text with the
UNCAPPED amount. The port hands the amount over via `pending_mana_effect` /
`take_mana_effect` (the `pending_hurt_sound` convention); the drain in
`world_sim/player.rs` spawns `combat_text::spawn_amount` at the player's own
hitbox with `HEAL_MANA = (100, 100, 255)` (`CombatText.cs:228`), the placement
`Next` draws riding the `UpdatePlayers` stream like the melee-hit text
(`world_sim/editing.rs`). The flag folds per tick: the Magic Cuffs (1595,
`ApplyEquipFunctional` `:14936-14939`) and the Celestial Cuffs (2221,
`:14949-14953`) arm `magic_cuffs`; `ResetEffects` clears it (`:18599`).

Documented gaps, all deliberate:

- **The crit ×2** (`Crit → num *= 2`, `:38248-38251`): the port's hurt callers
  carry no crit flag end-to-end (research/04 deviation 10), so the restore is
  always the un-doubled raw damage. The slot's order is preserved — the double
  would land on `raw` before the cuffs arm.
- **The +40 `statManaMax2` stat rows** (1595/2221 `:14925-14928`, and the
  982/6188/6189 band's +40/+60 regen `:14929-14934`) ride **S1-C-12** (the
  accessory stat chain) — the flag arms here, the stat grants land there.
- **2221's `manaMagnet` half** (`:14951`) is its own unported family (the mana-
  star attraction radius); only the `magicCuffs` grant lands.
- **The NetMessage 43 send** (`ManaEffect`'s `:4534-4537`) is MP-only, out with
  the port's single-player scope.
- **The respawn clears the pending text** (`respawn`'s pending strip) — the C#
  `CombatText` pool is global and survives death; the port's queue is per-hit
  one-shot state, drained the same tick, so nothing observable diverges.

`Main.DrawBuffIcon` (`Main.cs:43307-43368`) and `TryRemovingBuff`
(`:43370-43402`) are ported into `ui/resources.rs::draw_buffs` +
`player.rs::try_removing_buff`, over `DrawInterface_Resources_Buffs`'s grid
(`:43203-43250`: 11 icons per row from x=32/y=76, the 38/50 pitch, the
occupied slots packing). The per-slot alpha (`Main.buffAlpha`) lives on the
App (`buff_alpha`, initialised 0.4 — the C#'s first-draw clamp lands the
same value), the hover raises it 0.1 and the rest decays 0.05 clamped to
[0.4, 1]; the duration text gates through `TryGetBuffTime` (the

`SoundEngine.PlaySound(12)` MenuTick cue rides the tick drain.

Deliberate sequencing (not silent gaps):

- **The removal is a request**, not an in-draw mutation: the C# deletes the
